title: Generic agent tab screen
summary: The "+" on the tab bar now opens a "New generic agent" naming dialog that starts a generic agent with /grillo-generic in a tab of that name; 8 new tests, no shared file changed.
friction: CI was skipped for every pull request in this run: GitHub Actions has no minutes left, so on the person's explicit instruction the merge gate was the full local gate (build, lint, typecheck, suite) on the branch after merging origin/main. This clashes with BASE_CLAUDE.md and the project CLAUDE.md ('never merge on red or pending; no checks reported is red') and with the person's own rules file ('don't merge on red or pending checks'); Windows only was tested, the Mac half of the CI matrix never ran.

The first attempt (run Grillo-20261028-062239-2130, scheduled for 06:22 UTC) lost its session about 3 minutes after the four dev agents started; nothing was built and the four issues stayed assigned and in-progress until this run resumed them at 11:21 UTC, about 5 hours later.

Another terminal (run Grillo-20261028-111958-6832) rewrote C:\wt\in-flight.json at its preflight and dropped this run's four entries, because they still carried the first attempt's 06:22 startedAt (past the 4-hour stale rule); they were restored after the first merge. A resumed run must re-stamp its entries before another terminal's preflight reads them.
lessons_learned: Several /dev-next terminals on one machine need a machine-wide gate lock: parallel full suites turned 5000 ms tests red under load. This run added C:\wt\with-gate-lock.sh (an mkdir lock with a 20-minute stale cutoff) at the person's request; every dev and review brief should wrap its full gate in it.

deferred.what: Full-suite runs on a loaded machine hit the 5000 ms default test timeout in at least four files that pass alone in under a second (resources/skills/grillo-prd/grillo-prd.test.ts, ship-skills.test.ts, test/native-modules.test.ts, resources/skills/grillo-score/grillo-score.test.ts), so a gate goes red with no real fault and costs a rerun; it happened even with the gate lock, because other repositories' runs share the machine.
deferred.why: Outside every story's seam in this run; the fix (find the slow setup, or a deliberate per-file timeout policy) needs its own story, never a widened timeout to pass a gate.
